name: Active 911
description: Active 911 is a service that provides real-time emergency dispatch information to first responders. Alerts are written to CloudTAK Events with the responders of each alert as Assignments.

permissions.description: Active911 creates an Event for every alert
Active911 indexes the Events it previously created when its cache has no record of an alert
Active911 updates Events as alerts change and ends them once an alert leaves the archive window
Active911 assigns the responders of an alert to its Event
Active911 reads the Assignments of an Event to reconcile them with the current responses
Active911 updates the role of a responder as their response changes
Active911 removes responders whose response was withdrawn

schedule.description: Active911 sends a scheduled request to the app every minute to check for new incidents.
